autocad-helper.name: AutoCAD Helper
autocad-helper.description: EVLab's all-in-one AutoCAD productivity plugin — one install unlocks 24 category-wise organized tools for survey/point work, text & annotation, layer selection, and layout & sheet management. No setup beyond APPLOAD; type AH anytime for the full command menu.
autocad-helper.author: EVLab Tools
autocad-helper.installNote: APPLOAD দিয়ে AutoCAD_Helper.lsp লোড করুন, তারপর AH টাইপ করলেই সব কমান্ডের লিস্ট দেখা যাবে।

commands.description: Places a donut marker (survey point) at a picked location with a chosen diameter.
Switches the drawing's point style to a filled circle.
Turns selected POINT entities into filled, colored survey markers.
Places text (RL, chainage, etc.) at each selected POINT location.
Inserts a chosen block at every selected POINT location, with progress feedback.
Fast, no-dialog version of block-at-point insertion.
Changes the picked text/mtext content to "110".
Finds "90" inside a selection of text/mtext and replaces it with "110".
Underlines the selected text or mtext.
Builds an underlined "A to B" label from two picked text values.
Writes a chosen label into every selected circle.
Lists the layers found in a selection and lets you isolate objects on one of them.
Sets every layout except Model to the DWG To PDF.pc3 / acad.ctb plot style.
Sets every layout, including Model, to the DWG To PDF.pc3 / acad.ctb plot style.
Deletes stray text/mtext across all layouts (block text is left untouched).
Finds a text string anywhere in the drawing, zooms to it, and selects it.
Renames layouts with a chosen prefix and running serial number.
Reorders layout tabs by the number embedded in each layout name.
Jumps to the next layout tab, wrapping back to the first at the end.
Rotates a north-sign block to match its viewport's twist angle.
Duplicates the current numbered layout (e.g. (01)) as the next serial.
Drops in a dynamic sheet-number field tied to the current layout name.
Combines a sheet serial and drawing number into one label.
Locks or unlocks every viewport across all layouts at once.

surveypro-autolisp-suite.name: SurveyPro AutoLISP Suite
surveypro-autolisp-suite.description: 20 production-grade AutoLISP tools for land surveying & drafting automation — point auto-labeling, CSV coordinate import, spot levels, contour prep & labeling, closed traverse with Bowditch adjustment, bearing/distance COGO, road chainage & cross-sections, boundary area, coordinate tables, point QC, and one-click SURVEYPRO master menu with DCL dialog.
surveypro-autolisp-suite.author: EVLab Tools
surveypro-autolisp-suite.installNote: APPLOAD দিয়ে সব .lsp ফাইল (বা শুধু 20_surveypro_master.lsp) লোড করুন, DCL ও MNU ফাইল একই ফোল্ডারে রাখুন, তারপর SURVEYPRO টাইপ করলেই মাস্টার মেনু চালু হবে।

commands.description: Batch labels POINT entities with Point No, Easting, Northing, and Elevation with anti-collision offset.
Creates 3D AutoCAD POINT objects from manually entered or pasted Easting, Northing, and Elevation coordinates.
Imports thousands of survey points from CSV/TXT with automatic column detection and layered annotation.
Batch renumbers survey points sorted by geometric position (Left-Right, Right-Left, Top-Bottom, Bottom-Top).
Generates formatted spot height and reduced level (RL) annotations from survey points with customizable prefix.
Extracts XYZ mesh data, builds terrain TIN intervals, and separates Major and Minor contour layers.
Labels contour polylines with their true elevation oriented along polyline tangents.
Closed traverse solver with Bowditch/Compass rule adjustment, linear misclosure, precision, and formatted AutoCAD table.
Calculates Horizontal Distance, Slope Distance, Bearing (DMS), Azimuth, Delta E, and Delta N between two points.
Automatically creates aligned survey dimensions along boundary lines and polylines with smart offset sides.
Generates road stationing, chainage ticks, and formatted labels (CH 0+000, CH 0+020) along alignment polylines.
Calculates exact stationing and Left/Right offset of survey points relative to an alignment centerline polyline.
Generates road survey cross-section ground profiles, datum RL, offsets, and level labels in clean sheet tiles.
Plots road alignment longitudinal ground profile with horizontal/vertical grids, chainage axis, and RL bands.
Analyzes closed cadastral boundary polylines, calculates Area (m², Hectares, Acres), Perimeter, and vertex tables.
Generates professional AutoCAD TABLE entities with Point No, Easting, Northing, Elevation, and Description.
Scans drawing for duplicate coordinates, co-located points within tolerance, zero elevations, and outliers.
Creates and manages standard civil survey CAD layers with standard ACI colors, linetypes, and lineweights.
Deep drawing audit identifying zero-length lines, unclosed boundaries, overlapping text, and unreferenced survey objects.
The ultimate all-in-one suite command presenting an interactive menu & DCL dialog to run all 19 survey tools seamlessly.

civil3d-booster.name: Civil 3D Booster
civil3d-booster.description: Productivity toolkit for Civil 3D to automate surface labeling, alignment offsets, and pipe corridor editing.
civil3d-booster.author: EVLab Tools

autolisp-toolkit.name: AutoLISP Toolkit for Water Utilities
autolisp-toolkit.description: Collection of specialized AutoLISP routines to speed up pipe drafting and node numbering in AutoCAD.
autolisp-toolkit.author: EVLab Tools

gis-connector-plugin.name: CAD to Enterprise GIS Vector Connector
gis-connector-plugin.description: Bi-directional bridge plugin converting AutoCAD/Civil 3D utility vector drawings directly into enterprise ArcGIS/QGIS geodatabase features.
gis-connector-plugin.author: EVLab Tools

hec-ras-controller-plugin.title: HEC-RAS Controller Automation & Python Scripting Tool
hec-ras-controller-plugin.summary: Automation script library and COM interface for batch running HEC-RAS 1D/2D models, Monte Carlo sensitivity runs, and GIS output exporting.

qgis-geoprocessing-python-plugin.title: QGIS GeoProcessing & Survey Data Import Python Plugin
qgis-geoprocessing-python-plugin.summary: Custom PyQGIS plugin for direct import of total station field raw files, automated traverse plotting, and coordinate transformation.

bridge-section-property-calculator.title: Bridge Composite Section Property & Prestress Loss Calculator
bridge-section-property-calculator.summary: Utility plugin for calculating composite section properties, cracked section properties, and prestress losses.

tunnel-parametric-bim-plugin.name: Parametric Tunnel Alignment & Lining Generator Plugin
tunnel-parametric-bim-plugin.description: Civil 3D / Revit plugin for automated generation of 3D parametric tunnel segment rings along complex 3D alignment profiles.
tunnel-parametric-bim-plugin.author: EVLab Tools
